_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Special Equipment Tools and Test Equipment List
summary: This DID defines a listing of unique tools and test equipment required for the repair and use of the end item, used by the government to determine provisioning requirements for special equipment.
description_purpose: 3.1 A listing of unique tools and test equipment required for the repair and use of the end item. The listing is intended to be used by the government to determine provisioning requirements for special equipment.
application_interrelationship: 7.1 This DID contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: General.
preparation_instructions.content: The list shall contain a listing of unique items required to inspect, test, calibrate, service, repair or overhaul the end item. The list should be comprised of items other than those listed in Table I.

preparation_instructions.title: Format and Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The list shall be in the format shown on the sample data sheet in Table II. The first page of the listing shall include the identification information described in 10.2.1. The listing data shall have the format and content described in 10.2.2 to 10.2.6. Note, sample data is included in Table II for clarity.

children.title: Heading Data.
children.content: The top portion of the list shall consist of information to permit the identification of the end item with the listing i.e. Item Name, NSN, Contractor Name (Source), Reference or Part number, and Contract number.

children.title: Line Item Control.
children.content: Column 1 of the list shall be used for sequential line item control, commencing with the first line item (Item No.) on the first page and continuing to the last line item on the last page of the listing. Each line item shall represent a single support item.

children.title: Commercial and Government Entity code(s).
children.content: Column 2 of the list shall indicate the Commercial and Government Entity (CAGE) code(s) for each line item. Each line item shall list one or more entries. The first entry shall reflect the original manufacturers code (if available). Additional entries shall be included for the end item manufacturer or other sources for the support item.

children.title: Catalog Number.
children.content: Column 3 of the list shall indicate the part or catalog number assigned to the support item for each CAGE. If no CAGE code exists the part number shall still be listed. Refer to 10.2.3 for additional CAGE information.

children.title: Approved Item Name.
children.content: Column 4 of the list shall indicate the Approved Item Name which is listed in the H6 series of the Federal Item Name Directory, or the name assigned to the part by the manufacturer.

children.title: Unit Price.
children.content: Column 5 of the list shall indicate an estimate of the Unit Price.
